reference.title: Barbell Hang Power Clean
reference.listing: Video (title from the listing URL; the page could not be read from this environment, gymvisual.com is blocked by the proxy, so the movement is taken from the exercise name and standard coaching)
reference.note: Reference used only to identify the movement. No GymVisual media is stored here; this rig, model and animation are original.

breathing.pattern: Breathe in and brace standing tall, hold through the dip, jump and catch; breathe out once the bar is racked.
breathing.cadence: Dip about 0.7 s, jump and catch about 0.55 s

prescription.frequency: 1-3 times a week, early in the session
prescription.tempo: Controlled dip, explosive jump, fast pull under
prescription.load: Barbell load is user-chosen: light enough that every rep is fast and the bar stays close (NSCA guidance for power exercises).
prescription.progression: Add load in small steps once the catch is crisp and the elbows turn over fast.

cues.text: Stand tall, overhand grip just outside the thighs, arms long, feet hip width.
Push the hips back and slide the bar to just above the knees; shoulders over the bar, back flat.
Jump: drive the hips through, rise onto the toes and shrug; pull yourself under with the elbows high and fast round to the front.
Catch the bar on the front of the shoulders in a quarter squat, elbows up, then stand tall.
Drop the elbows, lower the bar to the thighs under control and stand tall for the next rep.

mistakes.fix: Arms long until the hips have finished the jump.

mistakes.mistake: Bar swinging away from the body
mistakes.fix: Keep the bar close; brush the thighs.
Whip the elbows round fast and high.

kinematics.setup: Standing tall, bar resting on the thighs, arms long
kinematics.peak: Hang just above the knees: knees ≈19°, trunk ≈31° from vertical, bar 67.3 cm high
kinematics.norm: Hang position just above the knees: shoulders over the bar, back flat (NSCA power clean guide)

kinematics.setup: Full extension on the balls of the feet, shrug, bar to the lower chest with the elbows high
kinematics.peak: Quarter squat, knees ≈46°; bar on the front of the shoulders (23 cm in front of the shoulder joints standing), elbows ≈25° from the trunk line
kinematics.norm: Power catch in a quarter squat with the bar on the front of the shoulders (clinical opinion); hang variations change the power profile (Suchomel 2014)

kinematics.setup: Overhand, 58 cm between the handle centres
kinematics.norm: Overhand, just outside the thighs (clinical opinion)

kinematics.peak: Jump and catch 0.6 s, stand 0.9 s, lower 2.1 s
kinematics.norm: Controlled dip, explosive second pull (clinical opinion)

cautions: Learn the lift with an empty bar or a dowel under coaching.
Use bumper plates and a clear platform.
Wrist or elbow pain in the rack: widen the grip or work on mobility first.
Stop if sharp pain, numbness, tingling or giving-way occurs.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
modify: Wrists: let the bar rest on the fingers in the rack.
